   **Bugs and stability.**
      15 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Aug 3, 2026 - Sep 7, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Kevin Eyebrows_, Sep 7, 2026, 1/5: "App slow and fails at peak times"
            2. _AMQ12_, Sep 5, 2026, 1/5: "This app feels like you’re transported back to 2015. It’s slow, glitchy and the UI is not friendly at all. Compare it to competitors like Voi and it seems like it is at least a generation behind"
            3. _jokal3112_, Aug 11, 2026, 1/5: "Absolute worst customer service I've ever experienced. My bike was broken, so I couldn't end the ride — the timer just kept running. I then tried every way possible to reach support: emailed 5 times (no response), called twice (couldn't get through), tried live chat twice (it's frozen), and even the email address listed on the website is no longer a working address. Not a single contact channel actually works. On top of that, I regularly lose minutes from my 1,200-minute subscription to broken bikes, and reported bugs never get reimbursed. I had to buy an extra 500-minute bundle, which is now being drained by the exact same issue. The referral bonus I was promised for friends who signed up also never showed up. An app you can't actually reach anyone through when something goes wrong isn't usable. Can't recommend this right now."
